comments.body:
Phase 1 RCA — confirmed before repair

Proven mechanism: the batched overlap judge constructs a native structured RunRequest without overlap-local output, retry, or elapsed-time budgets (src/rebar/llm/overlap/judge.py:173-182). It therefore inherits the generic 16,000-token / 600-second per-request settings (src/rebar/llm/config.py:117-128,478-480), and native structured validation may make OUTPUT_RETRIES+1 = 3 sequential generations before judge_batch regains control and safely abstains (src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py:225-286; judge.py:182,199-201). The generic timeout applies per provider request, not to the whole advisory episode, so it does not prevent three long generations.

Discriminating runtime proof: two live failures took 241.1s and 216.3s, produced malformed EOF responses of 47,973 and 21,351 characters with repeated candidate_id, exhausted both output retries, and then safely abstained. A deterministic FunctionModel probe through the real judge/runner path recorded max_tokens=16000 on all three baseline attempts and preserved all-candidate abstention. Holding the same malformed payload and 50ms generation delay constant, current retry policy made 3 calls in 0.178s; setting output retries to zero made 1 call in 0.062s with the same abstention. Applying output_token_limit=1024 alone changed the effective cap to 1024 but still made 3 native structured attempts, proving a token cap alone is insufficient. A 40,020-character completed payload was accepted by the current unconstrained candidate_id contract; a temporary max-length validator rejected it only after all bytes existed, proving schema tightening alone cannot contain latency.

Alternatives ruled down: batch size six is not independently sufficient—the c403 live-provider evidence successfully completed repeated six-candidate runs (599 output tokens)—and candidate-id echo is an observed model-side structured-output-collapse trigger/amplifier, not the executable containment defect. The parsimonious code defect is the absence of operation-local token + retry + elapsed-time bounds before graceful abstention.

Legitimacy: defect. Closed story 9022-d3e3-e97f-47e3 explicitly specifies a bounded pairwise classifier and timeout/error/malformed-output abstention; accepted ADR 0086 requires an advisory-only graceful skip. Multi-minute, multiply retried abstention violates that documented intent.

comments.body:
Final rebar-debug report — repair commit aa2b7f418ca975840650ef0f598f46871ad3fafd

Problem: malformed overlap candidate-id responses consumed multiple 16,000-token generations and multi-minute request windows before the advisory path abstained.

Proven root cause: judge_batch declared no operation-local output, structured-retry, transport-attempt, or timeout ceilings, so it inherited generic 16,000-token, three-generation, four-transport-attempt, 600-second policy. The Phase 1 RCA comment at 1786251659444495001 cites the original execution path and runtime traces. Closed story 9022-d3e3-e97f-47e3 and ADR 0086 establish the violated intent: the classifier is bounded and advisory, and timeout/error/malformed output must degrade promptly to abstention.

Proof: the real judge → PydanticAIRunner path made three 16,000-token generations before repair. A token-only mutation lowered max_tokens but still made three generations, ruling out output size as sufficient containment. Removing all four overlap-local limits after repair restored exactly three 16,000-token generations. Separate timeout and truncation mutations also restored RED.

Test: tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py exercises malformed runaway output, truncation, timeout, one-transport-attempt declaration, exact all-candidate abstention, and a valid reversed six-candidate control. tests/unit/test_runner_hardening.py proves zero structured retries means one generation. tests/unit/test_settings_builders_seam.py proves lower-only config behavior reaches model and provider construction. The held-out oracle was RED before repair, GREEN after repair, RED again under the defect-seeded mutation, then GREEN after restoration. It asserts observable settings/results and survives behavior-preserving refactors.

Fix: RunRequest now has defaulted lowering-only structured retry, transport attempt, and timeout seams (src/rebar/llm/runner.py:111-113). _effective_config applies timeout and transport ceilings before model/provider construction (runner.py:230-235). Both structured-output paths honor the request ceiling (src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py:217-218 and its native/prompted consumers). judge_batch requests 1,024 output tokens, one structured generation, one transport attempt, and a 60-second timeout (src/rebar/llm/overlap/judge.py:181-184). Existing callers omit these fields and retain prior defaults.

Scope and safety: the caller sweep found judge_batch only behind judge at judge.py:284-285 and overlap_findings at wire.py:55; callers depend on advisory abstention, not runaway budgets. The repair restores documented containment, creates no new entry point or external effect, adds no dependency, and weakens no existing test. Resulting modules remain under the 800-line hard cap.

Siblings/parity: no construct sibling was found; the missing limit was localized to this advisory operation. Channel census: the operation is internal to plan review through overlap_findings; CLI and automated plan review share that core. There is no direct MCP/API or public-library judge surface, and no dual-direction mirror. No MISSING parity surface remains.

Verification: held-out focused suite 56 passed; broader affected-surface suite 267 passed; make lint passed; make typecheck passed for 442 source files; git diff --check passed. The optional full default suite was stopped at 5 percent clean and is not claimed as passed. Local four-pass review-code at aa2b7f4 returned PASS with 0 blocking and 0 advisory findings.

Original-path replication: an overlap-enabled review-plan --source local --no-sign --force reproduced the original runaway candidate-id failure mode. With the repair, malformed orderings stopped after one generation in 22.7s and 10.1s, with EOF payload columns 2,975 and 1,053, returned overlap: [], and fabricated no finding. Full review elapsed 202.96s, dominated by normal review passes rather than overlap retries.

Residual risk and prevention: none observed beyond normal live-model variability; bounded abstention is now enforced by deterministic tests. Gerrit Verified remains authoritative for the full suite.

compiled_state.description:
## Context

During execution-phase plan review, batched overlap-judge calls took 216–311 seconds and returned oversized malformed JSON with runaway candidate_id content. The final catch safely abstained, but only after multiple long generations. Phase 1 proved the overlap call inherits generic 16,000-token, three-structured-attempt, four-transport-attempt, and 600-second-per-request budgets; it declares no overlap-local limits. The original 9022 story and ADR 0086 require a bounded advisory classifier whose timeout/error/malformed output degrades promptly to abstention. Runtime evidence is recorded in `rebar:22da-e9a6-63e7-49e5` comment timestamp 1786251659444495001; the c403 live valid six-candidate/599-output-token evidence is recorded in `rebar:c403-cc3a-2c6d-4b9d` comments.

## Proven root cause

`judge_batch` builds a native structured `RunRequest` without operation-local output, structured-retry, transport-retry, or timeout bounds. Generic runner policy therefore permits three full structured generations and transport retries before the advisory catch executes. A token cap alone still retried three times; schema validation alone acted only after the oversized payload existed. The durable runtime proof is recorded in the Phase 1 RCA comment cited above.

## Repair plan

- Extend the internal `RunRequest` budget contract with lowering-only per-request seams for structured-output retries, transport attempts, and request timeout, preserving current defaults for every existing caller. Keep `output_token_limit` as the existing lowering-only output seam.
- In `runner._effective_config(base, req)`, lower `timeout_s` and `llm_retry_max_attempts` before `run()` calls `_pai_model(cfg)`. The resulting effective `LLMConfig` therefore reaches `anthropic_model.py` / `bedrock_model.py` transport construction, including an injected/shared `PydanticAIRunner`, because that runner reconstructs the model/provider for each `run(req)`.
- Apply the request-local structured-retry seam separately in both native and prompted branches of `_pai_structured`; apply the existing output-token seam through `build_model_settings`.
- Give overlap judge calls explicit advisory budgets: 1,024 output tokens (the c403 live valid six-candidate response used 599), one structured attempt, one transport attempt, and a 60-second request timeout. Any bound hit continues through the existing logged safe-abstention path.
- Preserve valid verdict demultiplexing and aggregation behavior byte-for-byte outside budget metadata.

## Testing

- Unit/contract tier through the real `judge_batch` → `PydanticAIRunner` structured path with a deterministic FunctionModel. Prove the fixture reaches malformed runaway output, the current path is RED by making three attempts/inheriting 16K, and the repaired path makes one bounded attempt then returns exact all-candidate abstention.
- Settings-seam tests prove `_effective_config` lowers timeout/transport policy before model construction, while callers omitting limits retain current settings.
- Negative control: a valid six-candidate verdict under the bounded request retains label-keyed mapping and relation behavior.
- Mutation: remove the overlap-local limits and confirm the held-out oracle returns RED.
- Original-path replication: run an overlap-enabled plan-review scenario and record elapsed time, output size/finish reason, abstention result, and timestamp on this ticket; confirm no fabricated overlap finding.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A runaway overlap response is capped at 1,024 output tokens; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py -k runaway`.
- [ ] A malformed overlap response makes one structured generation; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py -k runaway`.
- [ ] A failed overlap request makes one transport attempt; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py -k transport_attempt`.
- [ ] An overlap request carries a 60-second request timeout; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py -k request_budget`.
- [ ] Timeout, truncation, and malformed output each return exact all-candidate abstention; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py -k bounded_abstention`.
- [ ] Valid batched verdicts retain label-keyed mapping and aggregation; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py`.
- [ ] Callers omitting request-local limits retain existing policy; checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_settings_builders_seam.py tests/unit/test_runner_hardening.py`.
- [ ] The held-out oracle returns RED when the overlap-local limits are removed; checked by the recorded mutation run.
- [ ] Focused tests, `make lint`, and `make typecheck` exit 0.
- [ ] An overlap-enabled original-path replication abstains within the declared bound and returns no fabricated overlap finding; evidence recorded on `rebar:22da-e9a6-63e7-49e5` with elapsed time, output/finish diagnostic, result, and timestamp.
